tabs.html:
Ruijie RG-EW3000GX PRO 3000M Wi-Fi 6 Dual-band Gigabit Gaming Router

Upgrade your home or gaming network with the Ruijie RG-EW3000GX PRO, a powerful Wi-Fi 6 router delivering up to 3000Mbps wireless speed for ultra-smooth gaming, streaming, and multi-device connectivity. Featuring dual-band technology, this router provides stable and fast connections on both 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands, minimizing interference and latency.

Key Features:

  • Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) Standard: Enhanced speed, capacity, and network efficiency.
  • Dual-Band Connectivity: Simultaneous 2.4GHz and 5GHz operation for optimized performance.
  • MU-MIMO & OFDMA: Efficient communication with multiple devices for reduced lag.
  • Beamforming Technology: Directs signals to devices for stronger connections.
  • Advanced Security: WPA3 encryption to safeguard your network.
  • User-Friendly Management: Intuitive web interface and mobile app for easy setup and control.

Technical Specifications:

  • Wireless Speed: Up to 3000Mbps (2402Mbps on 5GHz + 574Mbps on 2.4GHz)
  • Wi-Fi Standard: IEEE 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6), backward compatible with 802.11ac/n/g/b/a
  • Frequency Bands: Dual-band 2.4GHz & 5GHz
  • Ethernet Ports: 4 × Gigabit LAN ports, 1 × Gigabit WAN port
  • Processor: High-performance quad-core CPU (specifications may vary)
  • Memory: RAM and Flash memory optimized for stable performance (specific values depend on model batch)
  • Security: WPA3, WPA2 encryption, SPI firewall, DoS protection
  • Antenna: High-gain external antennas (number varies, typically 4-6)
  • Beamforming: Supports MU-MIMO beamforming technology
  • Other Features: IPv6 support, QoS, guest network, parental controls
  • Power Supply: DC 12V/1.5A (varies by region)
  • Dimensions: Approx. 230 × 150 × 38 mm (may vary slightly)
